# Civil Rights Movement Archive

> > A comprehensive archive of the Southern Freedom Movement (1951-1968) created and maintained by movement veterans from SNCC, CORE, SCLC, and other civil rights organizations.

This site preserves first-hand accounts, documents, and histories from civil rights activists who participated in voter registration drives, freedom schools, and campaigns in Mississippi, Georgia, Selma, and across the South. The archive includes personal narratives, freedom songs, and discussions by veterans including Bruce Hartford, Penny Patch, Gwen Patton, and others who worked alongside leaders like Martin Luther King and Stokely Carmichael.

## Key Topics

- SNCC (Student Nonviolent Coordinating Committee)
- CORE (Congress of Racial Equality)
- SCLC (Southern Christian Leadership Conference)
- Voter registration campaigns
- Freedom schools
- Freedom songs and movement music
- Selma and Montgomery march
- Mississippi organizing
- Black Power movement
- Movement veterans' narratives
- 1960s activism
- Stokely Carmichael
- Martin Luther King
- Southern Freedom Movement
- Civil rights organizing tactics

## Major Campaigns & Events

- [Selma & the March to Montgomery](https://www.crmvet.org/info/selmhome.htm): Archive of Selma & Montgomery march articles by CORE, NAACP, SCLC, SNCC vets
- [Black Power Movement](https://www.crmvet.org/info/bpwrhome.htm): Black Power archive: speeches by Stokely Carmichael, SNCC & movement vets
- [1968-69 BSU/TWLF Student Strike](https://www.crmvet.org/docs/nor/twlf/68strike.htm): BSU/TWLF strike documents from San Francisco State College 1968-69

## Veterans' Personal Narratives

- [Penny Patch](https://www.crmvet.org/vet/patch.htm): SNCC activist Penny Patch's biography: voter registration & freedom schools
- [Jo Freeman](https://www.crmvet.org/vet/freeman.htm): Jo Freeman's profile: CORE & SCLC activist in Brooklyn & beyond
- [Fatima Cortez](https://www.crmvet.org/vet/cortezf.htm): Fatima Cortez Todd: CORE organizer in Louisiana voter registration
- [My Family, The Movement, And Me](https://www.crmvet.org/nars/cadec.htm): Cathy Cade's memoir: SNCC activism & family impact in Georgia & Mississippi

## Movement Culture & Music

- [Freedom Songs and Singers](https://www.crmvet.org/info/songhome.htm): Freedom songs archive: SNCC Freedom Singers & movement music history
- [Record Albums of the Freedom Movement](https://www.crmvet.org/docs/albums.htm): Freedom Movement record albums collection: protest music & freedom songs

## Veterans' Discussions & Reflections

- [Lessons Learned in the Freedom Movement](https://www.crmvet.org/disc/1504_ll.htm): Stanford panel: Freedom Movement veterans share lessons learned & experiences
- [Louisiana & the Movement Experience](https://www.crmvet.org/disc/21lam.htm): Veterans discuss Louisiana CORE organizing & movement experiences
- [The Black Panther Symbol](https://www.crmvet.org/disc/panther.htm): Veterans discuss Black Panther symbol origins & Lowndes County organizing
- [Book Review: No One Ever Asked](https://www.crmvet.org/comm/jo26.htm): Review of Iris Geller's Mississippi & SCOPE voter registration story

## Reference & Resources

- [Civil Rights Movement Archive Homepage](https://www.crmvet.org/index.html): Homepage: Southern Freedom Movement history archive by movement veterans
- [Quotations From the Freedom Movement](https://www.crmvet.org/info/quotes.htm): Collection of civil rights & freedom movement quotations from activists
- [Freedom Movement Web Links](https://www.crmvet.org/crmlinks.htm): Directory of civil rights movement resources & research links
